title: AI Art Creation
subtitle: Transform your ideas into stunning artwork

textToImage.title: Text to Image
textToImage.placeholder: Describe the image you want to generate...
textToImage.tips: Tip: The more detailed your description, the better the result. You can include style, lighting, atmosphere, and other elements.
examples: A cute cat, watercolor style, soft lighting
Cyberpunk city at night with neon lights
Mystical forest with mist, fantasy style

negativePrompt.label: Negative Prompt (Optional)
negativePrompt.description: Exclude unwanted elements to improve generation quality

imageToImage.title: Image to Image
imageToImage.uploadDesc: Support 1-3 images, AI will blend features from each
imageToImage.dragHint: Drag images here, or click to select
imageToImage.tips: Use case: "Use this cat's pose + this painting's style + this image's color palette"

styleStrength.label: Style Strength
styleStrength.description: Affects creativity level. Higher strength produces more creative variations

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of images to generate at once

credits.insufficientMessage: You don't have enough credits for this generation. Please purchase credits first.

tips.title: Creation Tips
items: More detailed descriptions produce better results
You can include style, lighting, and composition in your prompt
Use negative prompts to exclude unwanted content
Try different style presets for varied effects
